_doc: Flow manifests — deterministic artifact checklists per gated flow. Consumed by loop_outer_gate.py (via loop_stop_guard.py when the marker status is 'outer'). Placeholders {scope} and {bundle} resolve from the marker; a null bundle surfaces bundle-based artifacts as missing with a next_action that registers the bundle. Verdicts come from files on disk (mtime >= marker.created_at - slack), never from narrative (ADW Law L3).

strategy-outer.description: loop-engineering OUTER (steps 1-9): recall + deep diagnostic + CCE exploration + persisted strategy
strategy-outer.preferred_next: touring adw from-template strategy-loop 2>/dev/null; touring adw run strategy-loop --var topic='<topic>' --var scope='{scope}' --var bundle='{bundle}'

artifacts.next_action: write the strategy doc into the bundle (strategy-<date>-<slug>.md) and persist it with touring memory store

cross-audit.description: TACO-cross-audit: 7 phases proven with executed evidence; the report file is the deterministic exit artifact
cross-audit.preferred_next: complete the 7 phases and write the report to {scope}/docs/audits/cross-audit-<date>.md

artifacts.next_action: write the phase-7 REPORT (with executed evidence) to '{scope}/docs/audits/cross-audit-<date>.md'
